paragraphs.source_en: From its initial publication, Wuthering Heights has provoked strong reactions from readers, and controversy over the novel has not abated. Lending itself to a variety of critical perspectives and interpretations, Wuthering Heights continues to be one of the most widely discussed nineteenth-century British texts. While readers can benefit from the many study guides that have been produced (one is noted below), essay collections provide a good initiation into the abundance of commentary on Wuthering Heights as well as offering a sampling of approaches to the novel itself.

units.source_en: From its initial publication, Wuthering Heights has provoked strong reactions from readers, and controversy over the novel has not abated.
Lending itself to a variety of critical perspectives and interpretations, Wuthering Heights continues to be one of the most widely discussed nineteenth-century British texts.

While readers can benefit from the many study guides that have been produced (one is noted below), essay collections provide a good initiation into the abundance of commentary on Wuthering Heights as well as offering a sampling of approaches to the novel itself.
